title: ローズSの後に・足りないエクステンド

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant… Wheeze… I can't believe I'm so exhausted after running just 1,800 meters… But I can overcome this with training!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My voice has started to sound like an alien again! And what's this? It's caused by epiglottic entrapment?!
